'''Shanahan''', sometimes known as '''''[[Dewback/Legends|Dewback]]'' Shanahan''', was a [[Fringer/Legends|fringer]] living in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] in the years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was known to appreciate alcoholic drinks and good tales, and sometimes he "arranged" favors in exchange for each or both.

Shanahan attended to the [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY]] in [[Tolea Biqua]], [[Genarius]].

==Behind the scenes==
Shanahan was played by [[Scott Lahna]] at the [[Gen Con Game Fair 2001]], who gave the character a characteristic accent.
